title: Create a Save Point
prompt:
Fill the object with the exact commands:
- `stage`: the command that stages every change.
- `commit`: the command that records a save point with the message `"Add navigation"`.
- `check`: the command that shows what's staged before you commit.

tests.name: stage everything
tests.hint: git add . stages every change in the project.

tests.name: commit with a message
tests.hint: git commit -m "Add navigation" — messages explain the why.

tests.name: check before committing
tests.hint: git status shows what's staged and what isn't.
